strings.verse.settings.markers_note: Hit markers differ by shape: ticks, ticks with a diamond, a ring, a square.
strings.verse.settings.title: Settings
strings.verse.tier.adaptive.desc: Starts at hard and moves towards an even fight as the set goes on.
strings.verse.tier.elite.desc: Fast, precise and patient. Wins more often than not.
strings.verse.tier.hard.desc: Breaches, flanks and punishes the same trick twice.
strings.verse.tier.normal.desc: A steady opponent who leaves you room to learn the hall.
strings.verse_settings.key_reserved: {key} is kept for the system and the Esc menu.
strings.verse_settings.live: Verse is running: changes apply at once.
strings.verse_settings.load_failed: The game settings could not be loaded. Is the backend running?
strings.verse_settings.offline: Changes apply the next time the Verse starts.
strings.verse_settings.preset_custom_hint: You changed a single quality setting, so the preset is now Custom.
strings.verse_settings.press_key_hint: Esc cancels. Mouse buttons work too.
strings.verse_settings.reset_tab_confirm: Restore every {tab} setting to its default?
strings.verse_settings.s.access.camera_shake.des: Shake from explosions, hits and landing.
strings.verse_settings.s.access.colorblind.desc: Shifts the colours of enemies, bolts and markers so they stay apart.
strings.verse_settings.s.access.colorblind.label: Colour-blind mode
Softens bright flashes from explosions and muzzle fire.
strings.verse_settings.s.access.high_contrast.de: Stronger outlines on enemies and interactive objects.
strings.verse_settings.s.access.reduced_motion.d: Calmer camera moves and menu animations.
strings.verse_settings.s.access.sound_visualizer: Shows footsteps and shots as markers around the crosshair.
strings.verse_settings.s.access.subtitles.desc: Text for crew lines and announcements.
strings.verse_settings.s.access.subtitles.label: Subtitles
strings.verse_settings.s.access.text_scale.desc: Size of all text in menus and the HUD.
strings.verse_settings.s.access.text_scale.label: Text size
strings.verse_settings.s.audio.ambience.desc: The ship's hum, machines and wind.
strings.verse_settings.s.audio.ambience.label: Ambience
strings.verse_settings.s.audio.effects.label: Effects
strings.verse_settings.s.audio.hit_sound.desc: A short click when your shot lands.
strings.verse_settings.s.audio.hit_sound.label: Hit sound
strings.verse_settings.s.audio.level_sound.desc: The fanfare when you or an agent rank up.
strings.verse_settings.s.audio.level_sound.label: Level-up sound
strings.verse_settings.s.audio.master.label: Master volume
strings.verse_settings.s.audio.mix.desc: Headphones gives the clearest direction of footsteps. Night mode keeps loud and quiet sounds close together.
strings.verse_settings.s.audio.mix.label: Audio mix
strings.verse_settings.s.audio.music.desc: The soundtrack on the decks and in the duel.
strings.verse_settings.s.audio.music.label: Music
strings.verse_settings.s.audio.mute_unfocused.de: Silence the Verse while you work in another window.
strings.verse_settings.s.audio.ui_sound.label: Menu sounds
strings.verse_settings.s.audio.voice.label: Voices
strings.verse_settings.s.controls.ads_multiplier: Sensitivity while aiming down sights, as a share of the normal one.
strings.verse_settings.s.controls.aim_mode.desc: Hold the aim key, or press once to aim and again to stop.
strings.verse_settings.s.controls.aim_mode.label: Aim
strings.verse_settings.s.controls.crouch_mode.de: Hold to stay crouched, or press to switch.
strings.verse_settings.s.controls.fov_duel.desc: Horizontal view in the duel. Wider shows more, narrower makes targets bigger.
strings.verse_settings.s.controls.fov_duel.label: Field of view (duel)
strings.verse_settings.s.controls.fov_first.desc: View while walking the decks in first person.
strings.verse_settings.s.controls.fov_third.desc: View while walking the decks behind your character.
strings.verse_settings.s.controls.invert_y.label: Invert vertical look
strings.verse_settings.s.controls.lean_mode.desc: Hold to lean, or press to switch.
strings.verse_settings.s.controls.mouse_smoothin: Evens out small jitters at the cost of a little delay.
strings.verse_settings.s.controls.raw_input.desc: Reads the mouse directly and skips the system's pointer acceleration.
strings.verse_settings.s.controls.sensitivity.de: How far the camera turns per mouse movement.
strings.verse_settings.s.controls.shoulder.desc: Which shoulder the third-person camera sits over.
strings.verse_settings.s.controls.shoulder.label: Shoulder
strings.verse_settings.s.controls.sprint_mode.de: Auto sprints whenever you run forward.
strings.verse_settings.s.controls.view_bob.desc: How much the camera moves with each step.
strings.verse_settings.s.controls.view_bob.label: Head bob
strings.verse_settings.s.controls.view_mode.desc: How you see the ship outside the duel.
strings.verse_settings.s.display.brightness.desc: Raise it until the dark corners of the hangar are just visible.
strings.verse_settings.s.display.frame_limit.des: A cap a few frames below your monitor's refresh rate keeps latency steady with adaptive sync.
strings.verse_settings.s.display.hdr.desc: High dynamic range output for HDR monitors.
strings.verse_settings.s.display.hdr.label: HDR
strings.verse_settings.s.display.resolution.desc: Native uses your monitor's own resolution, the sharpest picture.
strings.verse_settings.s.display.vsync.desc: Removes tearing but adds input latency. Leave it off when your monitor has adaptive sync.
strings.verse_settings.s.display.vsync.label: V-Sync
strings.verse_settings.s.display.window_mode.des: Borderless switches back to the app instantly. Fullscreen can cut input latency a little on some PCs.
strings.verse_settings.s.gameplay.auto_reload.de: Reload by itself when the magazine runs dry.
strings.verse_settings.s.gameplay.bot_tier.desc: How good the duel bot is. Adaptive matches your level as you play.
strings.verse_settings.s.gameplay.bot_tier.label: Opponent
strings.verse_settings.s.gameplay.gore.desc: Full shows blood and finishers. Reduced removes blood and cuts finishers away.
strings.verse_settings.s.gameplay.gore.label: Gore
strings.verse_settings.s.gameplay.kill_cam.desc: Replay how you were taken down.
strings.verse_settings.s.gameplay.kill_cam.label: Kill cam
strings.verse_settings.s.gameplay.show_duel_stat: Accuracy, hits and time to kill after each set.
TSR gives the cleanest edges and works with resolution scale. FXAA is the cheapest.
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.bloom.desc: Glow around bright light and laser bolts.
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.bloom.label: Bloom
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.chromatic_aber: Colour fringes at the screen edges.
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.depth_of_field: Blurs the background while aiming and in kill cams.
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.effects.desc: Sparks, smoke, laser impacts and debris.
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.effects.label: Effects
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.film_grain.des: A fine noise over the image.
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.foliage.desc: Plants on the decks and outside.
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.foliage.label: Foliage
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.global_illumin: Bounced light from walls and floors. Makes the hangar feel real.
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.motion_blur.de: Blurs fast camera turns. Most players switch it off in fights.
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.post_processin: Quality of the camera effects below.
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.preset.desc: Sets every quality group at once. Auto measures your PC on the next start and picks for you.
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.preset.label: Quality preset
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.reflections.de: Reflections on metal, glass and wet floors.
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.resolution_sca: Renders the world below your screen resolution and scales it up. Lower means more frames.
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.shading.desc: Material and lighting detail on every surface.
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.shading.label: Shading
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.shadows.desc: Shadow sharpness and range. One of the most expensive settings.
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.shadows.label: Shadows
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.textures.desc: Surface detail. Costs video memory, barely any frames.
strings.verse_settings.s.graphics.textures.label: Textures
strings.verse_settings.s.hud.crosshair_color.des: Pick one that stands out against the hangar.
strings.verse_settings.s.hud.crosshair_dynamic.d: The lines open up while you move and shoot.
strings.verse_settings.s.hud.crosshair_gap.desc: Space between the centre and the lines.
strings.verse_settings.s.hud.crosshair_gap.label: Gap
strings.verse_settings.s.hud.crosshair_outline.d: A thin dark edge so it stays visible on bright surfaces.
strings.verse_settings.s.hud.damage_direction.de: An arrow towards where a hit came from.
strings.verse_settings.s.hud.damage_numbers.desc: Show how much damage each hit did.
strings.verse_settings.s.hud.hit_markers.desc: A mark at the crosshair when you hit.
strings.verse_settings.s.hud.hit_markers.label: Hit markers
strings.verse_settings.s.hud.opacity.desc: Lower lets more of the world through.
strings.verse_settings.s.hud.opacity.label: HUD opacity
strings.verse_settings.s.hud.performance_stats.d: Frame rate, or frame rate with frame time and video memory.
strings.verse_settings.s.hud.scale.desc: Size of health, ammo and the other overlays.
strings.verse_settings.s.hud.scale.label: HUD size
strings.verse_settings.s.keybinds.ads.label: Aim down sights
strings.verse_settings.s.keybinds.crouch.label: Crouch / slide
strings.verse_settings.s.keybinds.fire.label: Fire
strings.verse_settings.s.keybinds.gadget_a.label: Gadget 1
strings.verse_settings.s.keybinds.gadget_b.label: Gadget 2
strings.verse_settings.s.keybinds.interact.label: Interact
strings.verse_settings.s.keybinds.jump.label: Jump / mantle
strings.verse_settings.s.keybinds.melee.label: Knife
strings.verse_settings.s.keybinds.prone.label: Prone
strings.verse_settings.s.keybinds.reload.label: Reload
strings.verse_settings.s.keybinds.sprint.label: Sprint
strings.verse_settings.s.keybinds.walk.label: Walk
strings.verse_settings.subtitle: How the Verse looks, sounds and plays. Everything here is also in the in-game menu (Esc → Settings).
